about.metaDescription: GoTalkify connects learners worldwide with professional native English and French tutors for one-on-one online lessons. Learn about our mission and values.
about.heroTitle: We believe everyone deserves a great conversation
about.heroSubtitle: GoTalkify connects learners around the world with professional native English and French tutors for lessons that are personal, flexible and effective.
about.missionP1: Speaking a new language changes careers, opens borders and connects people. Yet most learners spend years in classrooms without ever holding a real conversation. We built GoTalkify to fix that: every lesson on our platform is a live, one-on-one conversation with a professional native speaker.
about.missionP2: No crowded group classes. No one-size-fits-all curriculum. Just you, your tutor, and a plan built around your goals — whether that's acing an exam, landing a job, or ordering coffee in Paris without switching to English.
about.storyP1: GoTalkify started with a simple observation: the fastest learners we knew all had one thing in common — a personal tutor they met every week. But finding a great tutor, agreeing on a fair price and juggling timezones was harder than it should be.
about.storyP2: So we built a platform that takes care of everything around the lesson — vetting tutors, scheduling across timezones, secure payments and video calls — so that students and tutors can focus on what matters: the conversation.
about.valuesSubtitle: Four principles guide every decision we make.
about.value1d: Every tutor is individually reviewed and approved. We would rather have fewer, better tutors than an endless directory.
about.value2d: Tutors set their own rates and are paid reliably after every confirmed lesson. Students get transparent prices and a fair cancellation policy.
about.value3d: Lessons happen on your schedule, in your timezone, from anywhere. Consistency beats intensity — we make consistency easy.
about.value4d: Technology should get out of the way. We handle the logistics so every lesson is simply two people talking.
about.ctaSubtitle: Find your tutor and book your first lesson today.

howItWorks.metaDescription: How GoTalkify works: find a native tutor, book a paid trial lesson, buy hours or subscribe, and learn on a recurring schedule. All lessons on Google Meet.
howItWorks.heroSubtitle: From choosing a tutor to your weekly routine — here is the whole journey in four steps.
howItWorks.step1d: Browse our directory of approved native English and French tutors. Watch intro videos, read reviews, compare hourly rates and check real-time availability in your own timezone.
howItWorks.step2d: Pick a time slot and pay for a trial lesson at the tutor's regular hourly rate. It's a full one-on-one lesson on Google Meet — meet your tutor, talk about your goals and get a feel for how you work together.
howItWorks.step3d: Found your match? Buy a prepaid package of hours with that tutor, or start a subscription that renews every 28 days and automatically tops up your hours. Unused subscription hours roll over while your plan is active.
howItWorks.step4d: Set up a weekly slot with your tutor and make progress on autopilot. Join every lesson with one click via Google Meet, reschedule for free up to 12 hours ahead, and confirm lessons when they're done.
howItWorks.faqSubtitle: The three questions everyone asks first.
howItWorks.a1: The trial is a full-length lesson paid at the tutor's normal hourly rate. There are no discounted "taster" sessions — you get the real experience from lesson one.
howItWorks.q2: Can I use my hours with any tutor?
howItWorks.a2: Hours are tied to the tutor you bought them with, at that tutor's rate. If you want to switch tutors, our support team can transfer the value of your remaining hours to a new tutor.
howItWorks.q3: What happens if I need to cancel?
howItWorks.a3: Cancel at least 12 hours before the lesson and the hour is refunded to your balance automatically. Later than that, the hour is used — your tutor reserved that time for you.
howItWorks.ctaTitle: Your first lesson is closer than you think
howItWorks.ctaSubtitle: Pick a tutor now and have your first conversation this week.

faqs.metaDescription: Answers to common questions about GoTalkify: trial lessons, lesson hours, subscriptions, cancellations, Google Meet lessons, becoming a tutor and payouts.
faqs.title: Frequently asked questions
faqs.subtitle: Everything you need to know about learning — and teaching — on GoTalkify.
faqs.a1: No — the trial is a full-length, one-on-one lesson paid at the tutor's normal hourly rate. There's no discounted demo: you get the complete experience from the very first lesson, so you can judge exactly what working with that tutor will be like.
faqs.a2: After your trial, you buy hours with the tutor you've chosen — either as a one-time prepaid package or through a subscription. Hours are tied to that specific tutor and priced at their hourly rate. Booking a lesson simply uses one hour from your balance.
faqs.q3: Can I transfer hours to a different tutor?
faqs.a3: Yes, with help from our support team. Your remaining hours carry the monetary value you paid for them; that value is applied to the new tutor's rate, and you pay any difference if the new tutor charges more.
faqs.a4: A subscription bills every 28 days and automatically credits a fixed number of hours with your tutor each cycle. Unused hours roll over to the next cycle for as long as the subscription is active. You can cancel anytime — remaining hours stay usable.
faqs.a5: Cancel or reschedule at least 12 hours before the lesson starts and the hour is returned to your balance automatically, free of charge. Cancellations made less than 12 hours ahead — and no-shows — use up the hour, because your tutor reserved that time for you. If your tutor cancels, you always get the hour back.
faqs.a6: All lessons happen on Google Meet. A unique Meet link is generated automatically for every lesson and appears on your dashboard and in your confirmation and reminder emails. You just click and join — nothing to install.
faqs.q7: Do I need to confirm my lessons?
faqs.a7: After each lesson you'll be asked to confirm it went ahead. This releases payment to your tutor. If you don't confirm, the lesson is confirmed automatically 72 hours after it ended.
faqs.q8: How do I become a tutor on GoTalkify?
faqs.a8: Submit the tutor application with your bio, teaching language, hourly rate, qualifications and a short intro video. Our team reviews every application individually; once approved, your profile goes live and students can book you.
faqs.q9: How and when do tutors get paid?
faqs.a9: After a lesson is confirmed by the student (or auto-confirmed after 72 hours), your earnings — minus the platform commission — are credited to your GoTalkify wallet. You can withdraw your available balance anytime via Stripe to your bank account.
faqs.a10: Just a computer, tablet or phone with a camera, a microphone and a stable internet connection. Lessons run in the browser via Google Meet, so there's nothing to install. A headset improves audio quality but isn't required.
faqs.moreText: Our team is happy to help — get in touch and we'll reply within one business day.

privacy.metaDescription: How GoTalkify collects, uses and protects your personal data.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how GoTalkify ("we", "us") collects, uses and protects your personal information when you use gotalkify.com and our services. By using GoTalkify you agree to the practices described below.
privacy.s1p: GoTalkify is an online language-learning platform connecting students with independent English and French tutors for one-on-one online lessons. For any privacy-related question, contact us at privacy@gotalkify.com.
privacy.s2p: We collect information you provide directly: your name, email address, password, profile details (photo, timezone, learning goals), tutor application details (bio, qualifications, intro video), messages exchanged on the platform, reviews, and inquiries. We also collect technical data automatically, such as IP address, browser type, pages visited and approximate location, through cookies and similar technologies.
privacy.s3p: We use your data to operate the platform: creating and managing your account, matching students and tutors, scheduling lessons and generating Google Meet links, processing payments, sending transactional emails (booking confirmations, reminders, receipts), providing customer support, preventing fraud and abuse, and improving our services. With your consent, we also send our newsletter, which you can unsubscribe from at any time.
privacy.s4p: All payments are processed by Stripe. GoTalkify never stores your full card details. Stripe processes your payment data in accordance with its own privacy policy and PCI-DSS standards. Tutor payouts are processed through Stripe Connect.
privacy.s5p: We use essential cookies to keep you signed in and remember preferences such as your language. We use Google Analytics to understand how visitors use the site; the data is aggregated and does not identify you personally. You can control cookies through your browser settings.
privacy.s6p: We never sell your personal data. We share it only with service providers who help us run the platform — hosting (Vercel), database (Convex), payments (Stripe), email delivery (Resend), video calls (Google Meet / Google Calendar) and spam protection (Cloudflare) — and only to the extent needed to provide the service. We may also disclose data where required by law.
privacy.s7p: We keep your data for as long as your account is active and as required for legal, accounting or dispute-resolution purposes, then delete or anonymise it. Data is encrypted in transit, access is restricted to authorised personnel, and we rely on reputable, security-audited infrastructure providers.
privacy.s8p: Depending on your location, you may have the right to access, correct, export or delete your personal data, to object to or restrict certain processing, and to withdraw consent at any time. To exercise any of these rights, email privacy@gotalkify.com. You may also lodge a complaint with your local data-protection authority.
privacy.s9p: We may update this policy from time to time; significant changes will be announced on the site or by email. Questions? Write to privacy@gotalkify.com.

terms.metaDescription: The terms and conditions governing the use of GoTalkify.
terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: These Terms & Conditions ("Terms") govern your use of gotalkify.com and the GoTalkify services. By creating an account or booking a lesson, you agree to these Terms.
terms.s1p: GoTalkify is a marketplace connecting students with independent tutors for one-on-one online English and French lessons. Tutors are independent professionals, not employees of GoTalkify. All lessons take place online via Google Meet links generated by the platform.
terms.s2p: You must provide accurate information when registering and keep your credentials secure. You are responsible for all activity under your account. You must be at least 18 to create an account; lessons for children must be booked and supervised by a parent or legal guardian.
terms.s3p: A trial lesson is a full-length lesson charged at the selected tutor's regular hourly rate. Trial fees are retained by the platform. Each student may book at most one trial lesson per tutor.
terms.s4p: Prepaid lesson hours are tied to the specific tutor they were purchased with, at that tutor's rate at the time of purchase. Subscriptions bill every 28 days and credit a fixed number of hours per cycle; unused hours roll over while the subscription remains active. Cancelling a subscription stops future billing; already-credited hours remain usable. Rate changes by a tutor never affect hours you have already purchased. Transfers of hour value between tutors are handled by our support team.
terms.s5p: Students may cancel or reschedule free of charge at least 12 hours before a lesson's start time; the hour is returned to their balance. Cancellations less than 12 hours before the start, and student no-shows, forfeit the hour and the tutor is paid. If a tutor cancels or fails to attend, the hour is always returned to the student. Repeated tutor cancellations may lead to removal from the platform.
terms.s6p: All payments are processed securely by Stripe in USD. Funds for booked lessons are held by the platform and released to tutors only after lesson confirmation. A lesson is confirmed when the student confirms it or automatically 72 hours after its scheduled end. Refunds outside the cancellation policy are assessed case by case by our support team.
terms.s7p: Tutors apply through the application form and may teach only after approval. Tutors set their own hourly rates, manage their availability, and must attend booked lessons punctually. GoTalkify deducts a platform commission from each completed regular lesson before crediting the tutor's wallet. Withdrawals are made via Stripe Connect. Tutors are responsible for their own taxes.
terms.s8p: You agree not to harass or discriminate against other users, share offensive content, record lessons without consent, or attempt to move payments off-platform (circumventing the platform to pay tutors directly is prohibited). We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these rules.
terms.s9p: All platform content, branding and software are owned by GoTalkify or its licensors. Teaching materials remain the property of their creators. The service is provided "as is"; to the maximum extent permitted by law, GoTalkify's liability is limited to the amounts you paid in the twelve months preceding the claim. We are not liable for the conduct or content of lessons, which are the responsibility of the participating tutor and student.
terms.s10p: We may update these Terms; continued use after changes take effect constitutes acceptance. Material changes will be notified on the site or by email. For any question about these Terms, contact legal@gotalkify.com.
